about: teacher_training E41 Amendment 2, short links (reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_e41-teacher-path.md -> 'Amendment 2'; the approved branch for E41's P3 and P4 holding; decisions.md 2026-10-28 option (a): one batch order and one adversary start per link, a link between the lines is 'at the line'). Teacher: E41's emoticon fine-tune (E34's Adam 3e-5 arm A, all 24 matrices, batch 32, seed 0) regenerated in-job with checkpoints 1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000. Chain: link 1 from W0's (U, V) against T1, each later link from the previous link's (U, V) against the next checkpoint; 100 student steps per link (700 in all), E34's task-text recipe (Adam 1e-5, batch 32, arm A's weighting, Gamma and Delta frozen), fresh Adam per link, link i at batch-order seed i. Every link read through E34's harness beside its teacher's do-nothing state; links T10, T100, T1000 against E41's one-shot copies. RunPod 'NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3'. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0, 1, 2): faith_score.w0_check passes, the PGD floor is 0.0748 within 10%, and the seed-0 PGD KL is E41's 0.69882 within 1% (E41 and Amendment 1 equal to 16 digits). Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.C2: after the first link, before any warm start: from link T1's offsets via component_training.train's init, one step at lr 0 against that link's own weights; step-1 KL <= 0.005 nats (E41 0.0005) and delta-W unchanged to 1e-3 of its largest entry (E41 0). Fails: stop
controls.Delta: every link's Delta share <= 1e-6 (by construction ~1e-9); above it the run stops (a bug)
controls.G1: after the fine-tune: T10, T100, T1000 held-out P(target) within 0.005 and size within 0.001 of E41's (0.99931 / 0.01125, 0.99946 / 0.02217, 0.99961 / 0.03209). Fails: stop
controls.PC: before any link: T10's do-nothing state reads E41's 2.5159 within 1% (fail). The positive control (the check sees this early update when Delta carries it) and the proof that this job's harness reads as E41's, whose one-shot copies are P2's and P3's references. Fails: stop

measurements.do-nothing: per teacher T_k: delta-W in Delta, subcomponents and Gamma untouched, read the same way; the check 'sees the update' at T_k when this reads fail or at the line
measurements.per link: run.record's numbers through the harness (adversarial and stochastic ratios to this job's W0 at adversary seed 0, held-out P(target), teacher gap, damage, size, Delta's share); the check's verdict on the two ratios against the same-job floors, P(target) aside (pass <= 1.396, fail >= 1.612 at floor 0.0748, 'at the line' between); gap share = teacher gap / T_k's gap at W0; start KL = the loss on the link's first batch before its first update (its head start)

not_run: batch-order repeats of any link (decisions.md 2026-10-28, option (a)); adversary seeds 1 and 2
Pile-text chains; the r1 task; SGD or LoRA teachers
links shorter than 100 steps; carrying Adam's state across links; a one-shot copy trained 700 steps
the cosine of the chain's end with the one-shot T1000 copy; per-block ratios; saving states

predictions.blind_to: one fine-tune seed, one task, one batch order and one adversary start per link (a pass is a lower bound); damage outside 256 Pile rows and the held-out task windows
predictions.kind: three-way plus 'behaviour lost', filed with a lean
predictions.lean: at the line, medium (the T10 one-shot copies read 1 pass and 2 at the line over three batch orders; the links at T1 and T3 copy updates never read; from T100 on one-shot copies pass by 25% or more)
predictions.reading: pass: teacher training applied every 100 steps keeps every early update faithful, so it can run alongside training on this fine-tune. at the line: the chain is where the one-shot T10 copy is (decisions.md option (a) accepts that). fail or behaviour lost: a qualitative surprise
predictions.rule: per link k in 1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000: 'teacher too close to W0 to read' (left out of P1, its check verdict still reported) if T_k's gap at W0 < 0.005 nats (10 x E41's C2 hook-vs-merged KL, 0.0005: below it a gap share is a ratio of two numbers near the hook path's floor); else 'behaviour lost' if its gap share > 0.05 and its teacher gap > 0.005 nats, or if T_k's P(target) >= 0.9 and the link's < 0.9; else the check's verdict on its two ratios (pass, at the line, fail). Outcome: unscored if any link, teacher reading or gap at W0 is missing, or if every link is too close; 'behaviour lost' if any read link is; else the worst read link's verdict (pass < at the line < fail): 'pass' only if every read link passes. Ties: gap at W0 exactly 0.005 is read; gap share exactly 0.05, teacher gap exactly 0.005 and P exactly 0.9 keep the behaviour; ratios follow faith_score's lines (exactly 1.5 / 1.0748 passes, exactly 1.5 x 1.0748 fails). Reported beside: per link, whether the check sees its update (a pass where do-nothing also passes carries no information), the line a ratio is within 7.5% of, and the share of do-nothing's excess removed, (do-nothing - link) / (do-nothing - 1) where do-nothing > 1

predictions.blind_to: as P1; the chain has 300 / 500 / 700 student steps at the anchors against the one-shot's 1,000
predictions.lean: holds, medium (E41's three-link chain held every comparison with ratios 1.04-1.05x; the risk is the T10 link, 300 steps from W0 against the one-shot's 1,000)
predictions.reading: fails at T100 or T1000: short links pile up error the one-shot copy does not have, on the check or the behaviour. A miss at T10 alone sits inside batch-order noise (the one-shot copy reads 1.547 at the line, spread 21% over three orders) and is not read as pile-up
predictions.rule: at T10, T100 and T1000, the link against E41's one-shot copy of the same teacher: its check verdict no worse (pass < at the line < fail; the one-shot reads at the line, pass, pass), adversarial ratio <= 1.25 x the one-shot's (relative), P(target) >= the one-shot's - 0.01 and gap share <= the one-shot's + 0.005 (absolute; E41 P3's arm-A tolerances), all inclusive. Holds if all three anchors do; unscored if one is missing

predictions.blind_to: size is the largest relative change of one matrix; damage is on held-out task windows only
predictions.lean: fails, medium, on damage (E41's 1,000-step chain read 1.36x the one-shot's size and 1.49x its damage at T1000; step-10 copies do their teacher's full damage, 0.055, against the T1000 copy's 0.018, and the last link has 100 steps to shed it)
predictions.reading: holds: no pile-up of size or damage at the end. fails: the chain carries the early copies' size or damage forward, unseen by the check and the behaviour; a reset or a longer last link would be needed to match a one-shot copy
predictions.rule: the T1000 link's size <= 1.25 x the one-shot T1000 copy's (0.01842) and its damage <= 1.25 x the one-shot's (0.01801), inclusive. Unscored if the link is missing. Reported: both ratios, and size and damage over the one-shot's at T10 and T100 and over each link's teacher

reported_not_scored: every link's numbers, check verdict, gap share and start KL; every do-nothing state; the teachers' readings
